skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target, inflicts [Break] for 2 rounds, and restores own HP equal to 20% of ATK. [Break]: Decreases DMG Rate%.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Heals all allies for HP equal to 150% of King’s Max HP. Grants allies in the same row [Specialized Berserk] for 1 round. [Specialized Berserk]: The first strike deals [Berserk DMG] equal to 50% of King’s Max HP, can CRIT, and consumes 150 Energy Gauge for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Heals all allies for HP equal to 150% of King’s Max HP. Grants all allies [Specialized Berserk] for 1 round. [Specialized Berserk]: The first strike deals [Berserk DMG] equal to 150% of King’s Max HP plus 100% of [Specialized Guard] Max HP, can CRIT, and consumes 100 Energy Gauge for each enemy hit.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, allies in the same row gain [Overflow Recovery] for 3 rounds and recover HP equal to 450% of King’s Max HP. [Overflow Recovery]: Excess HP from Healing and Drain is converted into an equal amount of [Life Shield]. The total accumulated DMG removed cannot exceed 20× the unit’s original HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, allies in the same row gain [Overflow Recovery] for 5 rounds and recover HP equal to 600% of King’s Max HP. [Overflow Recovery]: Excess HP from Healing and Drain is converted into an equal amount of [Life Shield]. The total accumulated DMG removed cannot exceed 20× the unit’s original HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any ally acts, King and allies in the same row perform a [Combo Follow-Up], once per round. Allies in the same row share 50% Direct DMG with King. [Shared DMG] is reduced by 50%. DMG cannot be shared when King’s HP is below 30%. [Combo Follow-Up]: Deals 100% of the Ultimate’s DMG with 100% of its effects to random targets and is not affected by Hit Rate or Effect Resistance.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any ally acts, King and allies in the same row perform a [Combo Follow-Up], once per round and twice during the first round. Allies in the same row share 60% Direct DMG with King. [Shared DMG] is reduced by 80%. DMG cannot be shared when King’s HP is below 30%. Before any character acts, removes [Paralysis] from King and allies in the same row. [Combo Follow-Up]: Deals 150% of the Ultimate’s DMG with 100% of its effects to random targets and is not affected by Hit Rate or Effect Resistance.

effects.desc: Control status prevents the target from casting [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], usually for 2 turns.
Converts excess Health from healing and lifesteal into an equivalent Health Shield, up to a limit based on base Health.
